trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External user or application submitting transactions to the network. Transaction data is untrusted and must be fully validated including signature verification before processing.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Proposer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Validator or miner proposing blocks that trigger fork activation. Authenticated via consensus mechanism (PoS/PoW) but block contents must still be validated against protocol rules.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P network peer sending blocks for processing. Network peers are untrusted; all block data must be fully validated before acceptance regardless of peer reputation.

trusted_external_entities.name: DApp Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Decentralized application client subscribing to transaction completions via WebSocket. Client requests are untrusted and subscription parameters must be validated. No built-in authentication.

trusted_external_entities.name: HTTP RPC Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Client using HTTP-based polling for transaction completions. All filter parameters and poll requests are untrusted. Rate limiting recommended to prevent resource exhaustion.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Transaction bytes must be fully decoded and validated. Signature verification is mandatory. Malformed transactions must be rejected.
Block proposer is authenticated via consensus but block must still meet fork activation criteria. Invalid blocks are rejected by consensus rules.
Block data from network peers is completely untrusted. Full validation including header, transactions, and state root verification required before acceptance.
Subscription parameters must be validated. Resource limits should be enforced to prevent subscription exhaustion attacks.
Filter parameters (from, to, hasReturnData) must be validated. Filter count limits should be enforced per client.
Filter ID must be validated. Rate limiting on poll requests recommended to prevent DoS.
